mainEntity.name: How should research peptides be stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sealed lyophilized vials are heat-stable and can be kept at room temperature, refrigerated, or frozen; stability doesn't change much as long as the vial stays sealed. Protect from light and moisture, and refrigerate reconstituted solutions at 2-8°C.
